spec.title: HashiStack / Prometheus
spec.description: Self-observability of the gcloud-dc Prometheus: scrape coverage and cost per job, TSDB growth against the 8GB / 15d retention, rule evaluation and the alert set, process resources.

spec.title: Targets up
spec.description: Targets answering.

spec.title: Targets down
spec.description: Targets failing their scrape.

spec.title: Watchdog firing
spec.description: The always-firing Watchdog proves the rule engine is evaluating.

spec.title: Config reload OK
spec.description: 0 = the last hot reload failed and Prometheus runs the previous config (alert PrometheusConfigReloadFailed).

spec.title: Rule eval failures (range)
spec.description: Failed rule evaluations in the time range.

spec.title: Head series
spec.description: Active series in the head block.

spec.title: Samples / s
spec.description: Ingestion rate.

spec.title: Storage vs cap
spec.description: Persisted block bytes / the 8GB size retention. At 100% the oldest blocks are deleted early.

spec.title: Retained history
spec.description: Age of the oldest sample (time retention is 15d).

spec.title: Resident memory
spec.description: Prometheus RSS. The job's memory_max is 1536 MiB.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: Cores used by Prometheus.

spec.title: WAL corruptions
spec.description: WAL corruptions plus failed compactions since start.

spec.title: Targets up by job
spec.description: Healthy targets per job. Expected on gcloud-dc: node 11, consul 11, nomad 9, vault 1, prometheus 1, envoy 37.

spec.title: Targets down
spec.description: Targets failing their last scrape. Empty is healthy.

spec.title: Scrape duration (max per job)
spec.description: Slowest target per job. The scrape timeout is 10s.

spec.title: Samples per scrape by job
spec.description: Series exposed per job; Envoy dominates.

spec.title: Heaviest targets
spec.description: Targets exposing the most samples.

spec.title: Head series / chunks
spec.description: Head block size.

spec.title: Ingestion and churn
spec.description: Sample ingest rate and new-series churn (allocation replacement creates series).

spec.title: Block storage
spec.description: Persisted blocks against the size retention.

spec.title: WAL and head chunk storage
spec.description: On-disk WAL and memory-mapped head chunks. A WAL that keeps growing means checkpoints or head truncation are failing.

spec.title: Scrape interval accuracy
spec.description: Actual time between scrapes. Drift above 15s means Prometheus is overloaded.

spec.title: Alerts
spec.description: Every pending or firing alert.

spec.title: Rule group duration vs interval
spec.description: Evaluation time as a share of the interval; at 100% groups miss evaluations.

spec.title: Query latency p99
spec.description: PromQL engine time by phase. Dashboards and rules share this engine.

spec.title: HTTP API requests
spec.description: API load by handler (grafatui uses query_range, labels and series).
